text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh.
You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Absolutely!
I mean, I had the most incredible dream!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream where I ate eggplant at Mount Fuji
while watching hawks with Lady Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I'm well-rested, feeling great, and totally happy today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Lady Shiraoki
gave me the power to do my best~♪"

"Rather than divine power,
I think she just slept well...
Regardless, it seems she got some solid rest."
